data.raw_text:
You all saw it, 2025 was a year like no other for me.
I literally went to almost all the BABYMETAL tours of 2025. I made no plans for it. I took every chance and opportunity and went for it.

It was so intense. Sometimes I would like to have a way to show you my touring just so you can see how mad things can get. 

I was very lucky at very crucial times, like being able to go on and nail just right the US tour, and clutch job and commitments, into a crazy driving night with the mates, to be able to reach The Regent Theatre on time.
It would have been impossible without the collective effort of some of the most amazing people I have ever known, legends all of them.

That was beyond crazy, totally number one BM 2025 hyper stunt, it really was a trial of fire, but it was so worth it, and the rest of the year was also constellated with legendary moments.

1) First time across Asia and Mexico.
2) First time I completed the EU/UK tour (I came very close to in 2024).
3) Visited places I would have never thought about as a metal fan, like Busan, KL and Manila. Busan and Manila were also first time for the BM team.
4) I went to F1 for BABYMETAL (and it was epic).
5) Finished it all off with my first white kogitsune facepaint.
6) So many other cool fan moments, one epic fancam after the other (by the way don't forget to check my IG from time to time, I definitively want to expand).

It's so amazing I was there to witness all of it
I want to do it again for 2026, I definitively want to go across the world again for BABYMETAL. 🦊

1) I will definitively try to participate to most of the tours again, seeing different places and be together with different cultures is amazing, it's part of the fun.
2) I'm hoping to spend some time again in Japan, also because there are things I need to do there, so I would like to spend at least a few days. I would also love to catch up with lots of japanese mates.
3) Definitively hoping for LATAM tour, its the only one tour I still need to do. Mexico was absolutely amazing and I really want to do it again.
4) I want to become an actual kogitsune! 
Seriously I like that character idea. 🦊😋

And above all, keep progress as a fan with our amazing girls and pull more epic moments with our favourite twintailer 🤭😇 I really look forward what crazy situations will happen! 😋😋😋🔥

I am so grateful to Moa, she is probably the one person above all who saw me becoming, tour after tour, from a quiet baby fox to an absolute demon incarnate constantly on fire 🔥🔥🔥🤣🤣🤣
時々私は赤ちゃんキツネに戻る 🦊😇❤️

It almost feels like I am doing my part in all of this too
I cannot deny I want to continue what I am doing purely also because I desire to make a difference
If I helped my favourite team in any little way I was able to, then it makes me happy to continue. 😊😊

I am thankful to the BABYMETAL team, for making me feel incredible and to all my friends. I started solo touring for BM back in 2019 and now, everywhere I go, I know there is someone who recognise me and people who wish to see me again, you are really so many now and I miss all of you. 🫶

Let's have a good time in 2026! 🎉
お世話になりました! 
これからも頑張っていきたいです! 

See youuuu somewhereee! 🌎🌍🌏😋
Ciao! Ciao! 🦊🫶
Here is a photo with the usual suspects 🤣
#BABYMETAL
